chapter_meta_description: The Black-White College celebrates a new Celestial Immortal. But the biggest surprise comes when a hidden ancient ancestor emerges, gifting a shocking treasure.
og_title: A Thunderous Gift! The Hidden Ancestor Reveals Himself!
og_description: With the Diancai Immortal's breakthrough, the power balance shifts. An ancient being from the Primordial Fiendgod Era steps forward to secure their alliance.
twitter_title: Can't beat 'em, bribe 'em with top-grade treasures!
twitter_description: A new Celestial Immortal ascends, and a long-hidden ancestor emerges to make a game-changing offer in a bid for survival.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary epoch in Desolate Era's history, preceding the current Three Realms, when ancient chaos-born Fiendgods dominated the universe. Survivors from this era are considered nearly unimaginable powerhouses.
The highest quality tier of magic treasure commonly found in the Grand Xia realm, vastly superior to high-grade swords. A single one is a clan heirloom; a matching set of five is a king's ransom.
The heavenly ordeal a cultivator must face to break through to a higher realm. For the Celestial Immortal level, this includes the Wind, Fire, Thunder, and Heart-Demon Tribulations.

A cultivator who survived the Heavenly Tribulation but failed to become a Celestial Immortal, often because their body was destroyed. They are bound by time and must face periodic, ever-stronger tribulations to survive.

The most dangerous of the four major tribulations. It is a mental and spiritual attack that targets the deepest flaws and insecurities within a cultivator's Dao-heart, forcing them to overcome their inner demons.
The first major realm of true immortality in the Three Realms. A cultivator who has transcended the Five Elements and achieved freedom from natural lifespans.
